A City of Fayetteville page reports a site-plan presentation denial and later withdrawn appeal; the reviewed records do not establish that every campus phase has final site-plan, building-permit, certificate-of-occupancy, utility, or energization approval.

actions.access_caveat: Notice is a construction-activity notice and does not publish the underlying permit number.
actions.evidence_note: Construction evidence; not proof of occupancy, energization, or service.
